parameters.query: SELECT id, name, role, is_active FROM users WHERE id = $1

SELECT t.code, t.name, t.sport, t.status AS tournament_status, t.visibility, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date, t.match_days, t.area, t.city, o.name AS organizer_name, o.phone AS organizer_phone, q.need_scorer, q.scorers, q.need_umpires, q.umpires, q.need_stream, q.note, q.status, q.staff_note, q.youtube_url, DATE_FORMAT(q.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updated_at, DATE_FORMAT(q.confirmed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS confirmed_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_divisions d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS divisions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS teams, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_matches m WHERE m.tournament_id = t.id) AS matches, (SELECT MAX(d.fixture_pitches) FROM tournament_divisions d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS pitches, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(g.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tournament_grounds g WHERE g.tournament_id = t.id) AS grounds, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('role', f.role, 'name', f.name, 'phone', f.phone, 'has_app', f.user_id IS NOT NULL))  FROM tournament_officials f WHERE f.tournament_id = t.id) AS people FROM tournament_officials_requests q JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = q.tournament_id JOIN app_users o ON o.id = t.organizer_user_id WHERE q.status <> 'NOT_NEEDED' AND t.status <> 'DRAFT' ORDER BY q.status = 'REQUESTED' DESC, t.start_date, q.updated_at DESC LIMIT 300
